recognize_zh: 睪丸腫瘤由瀰漫片狀的中大型母細胞樣淋巴細胞構成（A、B、F、G），Ki-67 幾近全陽性（C、H），流式顯示 CD10+ B 細胞族群，FISH 見 MYC 分離訊號（1R1G1Y），支持高惡性度 B 細胞淋巴瘤合併 MYC 重組；BCL2 重組的 FISH 未在此圖呈現。
features: Touch/cytology preparation (A): monotonous medium to large cells with round nuclei, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm
Tissue (B, F, G): diffuse sheets of medium to large atypical lymphoid cells effacing testicular parenchyma, with brisk mitoses
Ki-67 (C, H): very high proliferation index, approaching 100%
Flow cytometry (D): 41% CD10-positive B-cell population across CD20 expression; (E) second plot shows a proliferation/DNA parameter
FISH (I): MYC break-apart probe with 1R1G1Y pattern indicating MYC rearrangement
describe_en: Composite figure: a cytologic preparation and testicular sections show diffuse sheets of monotonous medium to large lymphoid cells with fine chromatin, scant cytoplasm and numerous mitoses. Ki-67 labels nearly all tumor cells. Flow cytometry identifies a CD10-positive B-cell population, and MYC break-apart FISH shows a 1 red/1 green/1 fusion pattern consistent with MYC rearrangement. BCL2 and BCL6 FISH results are not depicted in this figure. In the context of prior follicular lymphoma and the stated double-hit status, findings are consistent with high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements.

ddx.vs: Burkitt lymphoma is BCL2-negative with MYC as the sole rearrangement (no BCL2 break), whereas double-hit lymphoma carries BCL2 rearrangement and often arises from follicular lymphoma.
DLBCL NOS lacks concurrent MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, which only FISH can separate.
Lymphoblasts express TdT and often CD34 and lack surface immunoglobulin, unlike mature CD10+ germinal center B cells.
Seminoma cells have clear cytoplasm with lymphocyte-rich fibrous septa and are OCT3/4, SALL4 and CD117-positive but CD20/CD45-negative.

stain: H&E; IHC: Ki-67; flow; FISH: MYC break-apart
